To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the PML-RARalpha chimeric transcript can be detected in 16 min by the RT-QLAmp assay, which is more sensitive than RT-PCR or RT-QPCR, and can be used in the routine diagnosis of APL.

1) we have developed a new, simple and fast assay to detect PML-RAR chimeric transcripts in APL patients; 2) this assay can be performed in less than 20 minutes and it is more sensitive than RT-PCR or real-time PCR; 3) this assay is particularly useful to rapidly diagnose APL and it can also be used to monitor APL during the follow up.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new, simple and rapid assay for the molecular diagnosis of AML.
the development of a rapid and sensitive molecular diagnostic method for APL, based on a new RT-QLAMP technology.
developing and evaluating new molecular diagnostic tools based on RT-QLAMP technology for the rapid, simple and specific detection of PML-RARA in APL.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
RT-QLAMP is a valid improvement compared to RT- PCR or RQ- PCR for performing rapid, simple and highly accurate molecular diagnosis of PML-RARA positive APL cases.
the RT-QLAmp is a very rapid and accurate method for the diagnosis of acute promielocytic leukaemia, but it is not a suitable method for the monitoring of minimal residual leukaemia.
the RT-QLAMPS is a valid improvement over RQ-PCR and RT-PCR for performing rapid, simple and reliable molecular diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia with the t(15:17) chromosomal translocation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RT-QLMPS assay is an easy, rapid and accurate assay to detect PML-RARα transcripts in APL patients.
RT-QLAMP is the fastest and most sensitive method to detect PML-RARα fusion transcripts in patients with APL.
RT-QLAMP is the new standard for the molecular diagnosis of acute myeloid leukemia with the PML-RARa gene rearrangement.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RT-QLAMP technology is a valid alternative to RT-PCR for the diagnosis of APL.
the new PML-RARA assays based on RT-QLAMP technology are rapid, simple, sensitive and specific.
the RT-QLA technology is a valid improvement in the molecular diagnosis of AML.
